verdict.rationale: Stripe documents importing existing subscriptions from competing billing systems (Zuora, Recurly, Chargify, Chargebee) and offers a no-code Billing migration toolkit. It also documents a multi-step migration of customer and payments data, which only implies card data transfer. missing for 10: explicit PCI-compliant card data transfer documentation, spreadsheet/CSV import evidence, evidence that the migration is seamless and invisible to customers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing

citations.quote: You can import existing subscriptions from third-party billing systems (such as Zuora, Recurly, Chargify, or Chargebee) into Stripe Billing.
Use the Billing migration toolkit to migrate your subscriptions without writing code.
Migrating your customer and payments data to Stripe is a multi-step process.
